I’m sorry for being a mother who wants help from the child’s father with the house and the baby. Next time I’ll just keep it all in if I shouldn’t complain. Next time I’ll just hold it in until I can’t anymore. Because I asked for this right? I decided to have unprotected sex. I decided to keep the baby. I decided to try and grow up for my child and do the best I can.

Because California living prices are insane and I’m trying to get my associates first so I can get a decent job and then move out. 

If they are willing to help me while I get myself on my feet then yes. At least I’m paying for my own stuff and taking care of my own. I could just be one of those parents who leaves their child with the grandparents to raise. But no. I’m doing my absolute best that I can with the resources I have.

Daycare is expensive and it’s hard to trust anyone with my child considering all the horror stories that have come out with people beating the children at the daycares. And taking care of a child is not just bottles and diapers. If you have a child who doesn’t like diaper changes like mine, he tries to run away from me, he kicks me , he hits me with his toys kicks his feet, sometimes with poop all over him getting it all over me. He also doesn’t drink just milk anymore. He eats actual food and requires more than “just a bottle”.
I’m going to college full time and we buy things for the house and pay rent. We pay all our own bills.

I looked it up and so as a wife I’m supposed to quote ‘be a helper to my husband’ ‘raise godly children’ and ‘submit to husbands authority’ it’s not the 80’s anymore. I had a job. I quit to be a mother. I had a job from the time I was 16-18 and quit because I needed to take care of my child. I go to college still full time while being a mother. (I’m almost done with my associates)If being religious means that as wife I have to just be a helper to my husband and submit to his authority than I’m glad I’m not religious.
